title: Juicy Jellied Syrian Vegetables Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Syrian dish made with briny, snappy vegetables, featuring a robata-grill and served in a ti-leaf wrap. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the mixed vegetables into bite-sized pieces and brush with olive oil.
Grill the vegetables for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
Dissolve the vegetable stock cube in 2 cups of hot water.
Add the ginger powder and lemon juice to the stock and stir to combine.
To assemble the wraps, lay a ti-leaf wrap flat and spoon some of the grilled vegetables down the center.
Drizzle the vegetable stock mixture over the vegetables and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
